Worrying about an aging parent who refuses help can be stressful, especially when their safety is at risk. Learn how to recognize warning signs, approach difficult conversations with compassion, and explore practical ways to protect your parent's independence while keeping them safe.
Brad Heineck, the late Bob Schrupp, and their team created the most famous physical therapy channel, helping millions stay healthy, fit, and pain-free. Bob’s mission lives on through his children and the Bob & Brad team.
